verdict.rationale: A government business-filing registry could plausibly publish an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary for a machine channel, so the axis applies. The evidence shows none: all OpenAPI candidate paths return 404. The only field-level description (docs-10) is a prose list of what the human-facing entity database contains, not a machine-readable specification. The filing host also refused automated connections, so no spec could be found there.
